a: Use your left pinky finger. A is its home key, so let your pinky rest on A whenever you are not using it.
b: Use your left pointer finger. Reach down and to the right from F, then go straight back to F.
c: Use your left middle finger. Reach down from D to C, then bring it back to D.
d: Use your left middle finger. D is its home key, so keep that finger resting on D.
e: Use your left middle finger. Reach up from D to E, then bring it straight back to D.
f: Use your left pointer finger. F is its home key. Feel for the little bump on F to find it without looking.
g: Use your left pointer finger. Slide one key to the right from F, then come back to F.
h: Use your right pointer finger. Slide one key to the left from J, then come back to J.
i: Use your right middle finger. Reach up from K to I, then bring it back to K.
j: Use your right pointer finger. J is its home key. Feel for the little bump on J to find it without looking.
k: Use your right middle finger. K is its home key, so keep that finger resting on K.
l: Use your right ring finger. L is its home key, so keep that finger resting on L.
m: Use your right pointer finger. Reach down from J to M, then bring it back to J.
n: Use your right pointer finger. Reach down and a little left from J to N, then go back to J.
o: Use your right ring finger. Reach up from L to O, then bring it back to L.
p: Use your right pinky finger. Reach up from the ; key to P, then go back to ;.
q: Use your left pinky finger. Reach up from A to Q, then bring it back to A.
r: Use your left pointer finger. Reach up from F to R, then bring it back to F.
s: Use your left ring finger. S is its home key, so keep that finger resting on S.
t: Use your left pointer finger. Reach up and to the right from F to T, then go back to F.
u: Use your right pointer finger. Reach up from J to U, then bring it back to J.
v: Use your left pointer finger. Reach down from F to V, then bring it back to F.
w: Use your left ring finger. Reach up from S to W, then bring it back to S.
x: Use your left ring finger. Reach down from S to X, then bring it back to S.
y: Use your right pointer finger. Reach up and to the left from J to Y, then go back to J.
z: Use your left pinky finger. Reach down from A to Z, then bring it back to A.
space: Tap the space bar with your thumb while your other fingers stay on the home row (A S D F and J K L ;).
great_job: Great job! None of your keys have a high mistake rate. Keep your fingers on the home row (A S D F and J K L ;) and try a harder level.
